title: Localization descent of the exact filtered object action
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories with derived categories and let $H:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive and exact. Then the record $\operatorname{FilteredTermwiseLift}(H)$ [def-trf-filtered-operation-lift-structures] is inhabited: the termwise action of $H$ on finite filtered objects descends to every finite filtered derived localization, with the specified total, graded, step-inclusion and localization comparisons.

source.place: Tags 015Q (lemma-filtered-localization-functor), 015S (equation-filtered-derived-functor), 05U2 (equation-definition-filtered-derived-functor), and the following equations equation-commute-gr / equation-commute-forget. Canonical operation/adjunction lifts: literature/varshavsky-lefschetz-verdier-trace-formula_arXiv-math0505564.pdf, Lemma 5.1.4 and §§5.2.1–5.2.2; the pro-etale compactification-relative formulation is assembled from the same filtered-injective construction.

proof.text: Take the additive action and its total/graded comparisons from lem-trf-exact-filtered-object-action. The homotopy comparisons identify a graded map after the action with H of the original graded map. Since H is exact, its ordinary derived functor shows this image is a quasi-isomorphism. Localize the homotopy action, descend its shift compatibility, and use essential surjectivity on arrows to descend triangulatedness. Descend the total/graded homotopy comparison isomorphisms by the fully faithful precomposition functor for localization. Retain the object and step comparisons to fill the full termwise lift record.
